reviews.title: BEWARE: SUBSCRIPTION TRAP & HIDDEN CHARGES
reviews.text:
Do not download this app. It lures you in with a cheap $1 to $3 trial on their website/app, but then buries auto-renewal terms in the fine print. They will immediately start hitting your card with unauthorized weekly or monthly charges ranging from $40 to over $100. Worse, the app makes it nearly impossible to cancel, and some users report phantom charges even after deleting it. The US Federal Trade Commission has actually filed a lawsuit against the developers for fraud. Protect your wallet and stay away!

I’ll be reporting this app to be delisted from App Store. You can do so by “Report a Problem” under very bottom of the App Store page.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text:
Nebula is one of those apps that immediately pulls you in with its sleek design and mystical vibe. From the moment you open it, everything feels polished and easy to navigate, which makes exploring your birth chart, daily horoscopes, and compatibility readings surprisingly fun.

What really stands out is how detailed and personalized the insights are. Instead of generic horoscope blurbs, Nebula gives you in-depth explanations that actually feel tailored to you. The relationship compatibility feature is especially engaging—it breaks things down in a way that’s both insightful and entertaining.

That said, some of the deeper features sit behind a paywall, which might not appeal to everyone. But if you’re genuinely into astrology, the extra content can be worth it.

Overall, Nebula is a visually beautiful, content-rich astrology app that blends entertainment with self-reflection. Whether you’re a casual horoscope reader or someone who loves diving deep into charts, it’s definitely worth checking out.

reviews.title: A Pocket Universe for Curious Minds
reviews.text:
Nebula feels like a quiet, glowing library you can carry around without the dust or the shushing. It’s thoughtful, polished, and clearly made by people who care about ideas, not just algorithms. The content leans smart without being smug, and creative without trying too hard. Every video feels intentional, like it was placed there for a reason, not just because it might go viral.

What really sets Nebula apart is the atmosphere. There’s no frantic scrolling, no sensory overload. Just long-form thinking, calm pacing, and creators who are allowed to breathe and finish a thought. It’s the kind of app you open when you want to feel a little more awake afterward, not just entertained.

The interface is clean and intuitive, letting the content take center stage. It’s easy to lose track of time in the best way, hopping from philosophy to science to storytelling without feeling pulled in a hundred directions. Nebula doesn’t beg for your attention. It trusts you to give it willingly.

If you’re tired of loud platforms and disposable content, Nebula feels like a small rebellion. A place where curiosity still matters, and depth hasn’t gone out of style.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: The daily horoscopes are fun to read while getting ready for the day. You can also read more about your Zodiac, star, sun, and moon signs, but it’s nothing you can’t also find on any astrology app or website. The compatibility reading is a 7 day program that is super generic, not at all personalized or any sense of nuance or emotional intelligence regarding your specific POI, situation etc. I only chatted with a psychic for the 3 free minutes because $3.99 per minute of an online psychic is crazy and they clearly prey on people’s vulnerability. You’re far better off finding a local in-person tarot reader and getting a reading in a physical space. If they’re legit, they won’t make false promises, they won’t speak like AI, and they’ll use actual intuition to guide you, offer clarity and maybe a new perspective. To compare, my city has a Wiccan store with a reader every weekend and she charges $40 for 30 minutes and is deeply skilled, kind, and intuitive. If they try to upsell you (i.e. buy more minutes) it’s a scam to get more money. I won’t keep this app more than the free trial.
reviews.reply: Hello there! Thank you for taking the time to share such thoughtful and detailed feedback. We’re sorry that parts of your experience didn’t meet your expectations. reviews.title: STEER CLEAR OF THIS APP!!!
reviews.text:
I downloaded the app to check my natal, birth chart one time I had no intentions of using the app beyond that.

They stated that there was a trial period for the app and after that I’d be charged the monthly fee. I looked through my app couldn’t find any active subscription. I thought it had been canceled. Checked my Apple subscriptions. Didn’t see anything come up there and then a week later got charged for $60 Canadian. For an app that I had no intention of using.

I contacted their customer service. Their AI. Customer service rep was unable to find my account under the email that it apparently had been set up for indicating that the subscription likely would’ve been canceled. I asked repeatedly to have my money returned to me. Their AI support was able to cancel the account it has been unable to find prior and told me that no further charges would be coming off my bank card. 

I told the AI support rep that that was unacceptable on that because they can obviously see that I hadn’t used the app after the first time that it had been downloaded and then I had done my due diligence and getting in contact with them immediately after there was a charge to my card they should be willing to refund my money mean that there were no service services used beyond the initial stage.

Their Support offered me a refund of 50% and tokens to be used through the app. I told him that was unacceptable and I had no desire to use their app. They refuse to offer me my money back stating that their terms of service services stated that if I didn’t cancel my subscription before the specified date that I would be subject to the church and legally, they were entitled to the money.

I assure you guys is impossible to find your subscription on this app. They have three or four different places that the subscription could be logged, depending on which mode you used to download the app and set up your account.

Be very careful using this app everything cost money and the support is unhelpful. You’re going to get stuck with a subscription and you’re going to have $42 US come off your card at seven days after you set up this app.

I’M LIVID WITH HOW THIS SITUATION WORKED OUT I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS APP TO ANOTHER PERSON EVER!!!!!!!

reviews.title: The old Bait & Switch
reviews.text:
What a huge disappointment. I got suckered in with a Facebook post about reading your palm. Next thing I know I’m getting pulled into the Nebula app. There’s no mention that there’s going to be any fee for the free reading and the app claims to be for free.  Then all of a sudden you’re asked to make a payment. And you can’t exit out of the app, so for me being in Canada that’s a $45 charge. It’s ridiculous. Then I was concerned that maybe this was a subscription app and that this is going to be an ongoing fee. However, it does not appear in my Apple subscriptions, and when I come back into the App Store, I don’t see any mention of this app being subscription based.

Disappointing and frustrating, as you would think that in today’s day of consumers demanding more and more transparency, that this sort of thing wouldn’t keep happening. 

Way to go Apple, thx a lot. NOT.😤😠😡🤬

The Horoscope side of things aka: The “Single Player Game Mode, is pretty good. They give you a decent look ahead and that’s about par for this genre. Half do it this way and half do it the other way, a day or two at a time. 

They also have a Questions side of things, aka: The Multi-Player/Co-Op Game Mode), is where a lot of action happens. 
At first I didn’t really like it because it didn’t seem very attractive. Once I tried it out, I ended up looking forward to seeing the answers to the questions that I asked the Psychics/Seers and Readers. 

I wish we could give half stars because it really is Better than a 3/5.  
If I could I would give it a 3.5/5. If they made it more esthetically appealing then I would have given it a 4/5.

reviews.title: AVOID!
reviews.text:
I originally left a negative review in January 2026 about being wrongly charged, and somehow that review has now disappeared - yet Nebula just recently replied to it months later. That alone is concerning.

My experience: I downloaded the app from an ad and paid $1 for a palm reading. I did not sign up for any subscription or auto-renew. Apple Subscriptions showed nothing, and I received no confirmation email.

A week later, I was charged $61.25.

Support was useless - their chatbot claimed there was no record of the charge, even after I provided screenshots. I had to go through a chargeback process and cancel my credit card to resolve it. Thankfully, I did get my money back, but only through my bank - not Nebula.

It’s been months and I’ve still never received a proper response from a real person.

After digging online, I found multiple people reporting the exact same issue. This doesn’t feel like a one-off mistake.

Use extreme caution.
